cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: '>=' -> '>' in afterStart. If boundary is non-inclusive, Fri 16:00 reads as inactive and the blocking constraint is missed.
cases.note: Window Fri16:00->Sun07:45. simtime=Friday exactly 16:00 (start boundary, inclusive). Window must be ACTIVE -> nodests blocks EGLL.

cases.adversarial: Paired with ADVERS_time_start_boundary_exact_active. Confirms the window is correctly INACTIVE one minute before start.
cases.note: Window Fri16:00->Sun07:45. simtime=Friday 15:59 (one minute before start). Window must be INACTIVE -> constraint does not apply -> PASS.

cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: '<=' -> '<' in beforeEnd. If boundary is non-inclusive, Sun 07:45 reads as inactive and the constraint is silently dropped too early.
cases.note: Window Fri16:00->Sun07:45. simtime=Sunday exactly 07:45 (end boundary, inclusive). Window must be ACTIVE -> nodests blocks EGLL.

cases.adversarial: Paired with ADVERS_time_end_boundary_exact_active. Confirms the window is correctly INACTIVE one minute after end.
cases.note: Window Fri16:00->Sun07:45. simtime=Sunday 07:46 (one minute after end). Window must be INACTIVE -> PASS.

cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: rfind(prefix,0) -> find(prefix,0) in cc_destPrefixMatch. With find(), 'LEGE'.find('EG',0) returns pos 1 (non-prefix match) and wrongly blocks a French airport. rfind(prefix,0) correctly enforces prefix-only matching.
cases.note: 'EG' appears at position 1 in 'LEGE' but LEGE does not START with 'EG'. nodests=['EG'] must not block it.

cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: remove 'c[max].GetInt() > 0' guard in checkOneMinMax. Without the guard, max=0 computes (rfl/100) > 0 which is true for any positive FL, wrongly blocking all traffic.
cases.note: max=0 is the 'no upper ceiling' sentinel. FL360 must pass when max=0.

cases.adversarial: Tests that noroute (more specific) fires even when route (less specific) matches. A bug treating route-match as sufficient would return PASS incorrectly.
cases.note: constraint has route=['TLA Y96'] (2-token prefix) AND noroute=['TLA Y96 NATEB'] (3-token). Flight ['TLA','Y96','NATEB'] matches both: route passes (2-prefix match) but noroute also matches -> must FAIL.

cases.adversarial: Paired with ADVERS_route_and_noroute_specific_exclusion_fails. A different 3rd waypoint satisfies route but avoids noroute — must PASS.
cases.note: Same constraint. Flight ['TLA','Y96','ATSIX']: route=['TLA Y96'] matches (prefix), noroute=['TLA Y96 NATEB'] does not (ATSIX!=NATEB) -> must PASS.

cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: swapping nodests/dests evaluation order. If dests were checked first, EGLL would pass the whitelist and the nodests block would be bypassed. nodests must fire first — dead combination.
cases.note: dests=['EGLL'] and nodests=['EG']. EGLL starts with 'EG' so nodests fires before dests can rescue it -> must FAIL.

cases.adversarial: Catches mutation: removing 'pattern.size() > rte.size()' guard in cc_routeHas. Without the guard, a too-long noroute pattern would access rte out-of-bounds, causing a crash or wrong result. The guard must silently skip it.
cases.note: noroute=['TLA Y96 NATEB'] (3 tokens). Flight route has only 2 waypoints ['TLA','Y96']. Pattern cannot match -> noroute not triggered -> must PASS.
Constraint blocks GOMUP exit. Flight exits via BALIX — not in nopoints list — must pass.

points=['GOMUP','BELZU'] (whitelist) and nopoints=['GOMUP'] (blacklist). Flight exits via GOMUP — whitelisted but also forbidden — nopoints fires and must FAIL. Tests that nopoints is evaluated after points whitelist match.

points=['GOMUP','BELZU'] (whitelist) and nopoints=['GOMUP']. Flight exits via BELZU — whitelisted and NOT in nopoints — must pass. Confirms nopoints only fires when the specific forbidden point is used.
Above RVSM_UPPER: ODD uses ((rfl-41000)/1000)%4==0. FL430=2%4=2!=0 -> FAIL. FL430 is the EVEN slot above FL410.
Above RVSM_UPPER: EVEN uses ((rfl-41000)/1000)%4==2. FL450=4%4=0!=2 -> FAIL. FL450 looks 'even' as a number but is the ODD slot above FL410.
Confirms the above-FL410 EVEN pattern repeats. FL470=(47000-41000)/1000=6, 6%4=2 -> PASS.
FL410 (rfl=41000) is NOT above RVSM_UPPER (41000 is not > 41000), so standard RVSM formula applies: (41000/1000)%2=41%2=1 -> ODD. Boundary between the two regimes.
FL410 uses standard RVSM: 41%2=1, which is ODD not EVEN -> FAIL. Paired with DIR_FL410_exact_boundary_ODD to confirm the boundary belongs to the RVSM regime.
